title: EgoHand: Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
abstract: arXiv:2610.30293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce EgoHand, a monocular 3D hand reconstruction model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on egocentric video. Central to our approach is the curation of a high-quality training corpus of 14 million images, combining synthetic data, in-the-wild video, and multi-camera motion capture to balance scene diversity and supervision quality. The model adopts SOMA-Hand as its parametric representation and processes 2D hand crops with a transformer encoder, incorporating camera cues and an auxiliary 2D branch to improve geometric consistency and image alignment. Zero-shot evaluations on HOT3D, ARCTIC, and H2O demonstrate strong out-of-domain generalization, with lower joint-position, root-translation, and acceleration errors than competing baselines at an inference latency of approximately 9.69 ms. A blinded user preference study further shows that participants favor EgoHand's reconstructed hand poses over those from Apple EgoDex

translated_title: EgoHand：基于自我中心视频的单目3D手部重建
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EgoHand，一个在自我中心（第一视角）视频上实现最先进性能的单目3D手部重建模型。我们方法的核心是构建了一个包含1400万张图像的高质量训练语料库，结合了合成数据、真实场景视频和多相机动作捕捉，以平衡场景多样性与监督质量。该模型采用SOMA-Hand作为其参数化表示，使用transformer编码器处理2D手部裁剪图像，并融入相机线索和辅助2D分支以提升几何一致性和图像对齐效果。在HOT3D、ARCTIC和H2O数据集上的零样本评估展示了强大的跨域泛化能力，在约9.69毫秒的推理延迟下，其关节位置、根平移和加速度误差均低于竞争基线方法。一项盲测用户偏好研究进一步表明，参与者更青睐EgoHand重建的手部姿态，而非Apple EgoDex的结果。
tldr: EgoHand是基于1400万张图像高质量语料库训练的单目3D手部重建模型，在自我中心视频上实现了最先进的性能，具备强大的零样本跨域泛化能力和约9.69毫秒的低推理延迟。
en_tdlr: EgoHand is a monocular 3D hand reconstruction model trained on a 14-million-image corpus that achieves state-of-the-art performance on egocentric video, with strong zero-shot generalization and approximately 9.69 ms inference latency.
